The Chairman of the MDC, serving in an ex officio capacity, shall preside at all
meetings of the MDC and ensure that all policies, directives, plans and programs
of the MDC are faithfully carried out.
There shall also be an Executive Director with the rank of Undersecrelary, who
shall be appointed by the President and who shall manage the day-today affairs
The representatives from the members of the MDC shall have the rank of

All other provisions of the said Order shall remain in force.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
